x: Such a fine race as it was the lot of our Club to promote is seldom seen Yet again T W Green, "our star artist of fair walking" (F G T ) wore down his opponents and accomplished a performance second only to that of Goodwin who in 1924 won in 54m 9s
Poynton of the Derby W.C. was the first man home and, of course, that delighted the residents, followed by Goodwin of the S.W.C.
100 yards (Seniors) second race: 1 Clay (R.S.); 2 McKeown (B); 3 Pallett (L.F.F.); 4 Goodwin (D.).
